response.headline: Revenue grew 3.5% to £72.9k in September.

notes.text: Revenue was £2.5k higher than in August, and gross margin held at 84.2%. Net monthly burn eased to £61.4k from £61.7k. Operating expenses of £122.8k are still well above revenue, so burn remains the figure to watch.

board_questions: When do we expect revenue to cover operating expenses?
What brought burn down in September?
